result.description: Gold-standard kidney-detection benchmark for the Renal Health Vertical (RHV). v0.2: 200 renal ultrasound images (120 automated-label + 80 manual-label) -- the full 200-image target, reached -- across 5 pseudonymised hospitals (Hosp1-Hosp5), with radiologist-confirmed kidney bounding boxes on MaskedCone (cone-cropped) DICOMs only. 1 automated candidate (of 121 confirmed) was dropped for lowest detector confidence to land on a clean 120. On the manual side, 3 segmentation exports were found empty (no region drawn) and excluded pending re-annotation (not part of this 200); 3 further exports were initially unmatched due to a single-digit filename typo and were recovered via exact-pixel-dimension matching against the MaskedCone manifest, each visually verified before inclusion. This version's `test_points` recordSet embeds every field inline (exact relative file path, pixel + normalized ground-truth box, depth/angle, patient demographics, split) as JSON `data` -- a consumer (frontend, evaluation script) needs only this file to render, filter, and score against this benchmark; the traditional per-purpose CSVs (ground truth, tracking, master cohort) are still provided and described via the schema-over-CSV recordSets below for standard Croissant tooling. EVALUATION-ONLY DATASET: held out from any RHV model-training pool -- do not use for training. De-identification: source DICOM PatientName/PatientID tags are anonymized (pseudonymous case IDs); no direct patient identifiers are retained. Measurement techniques: automated-pathway boxes from a YOLOv11 kidney detector (fresh inference, radiologist Yes/No verdict review, Yes-only retained); manual-pathway boxes derived from full radiologist kidney segmentation (NIfTI mask -> tight bounding box). Depth from DICOM ultrasound-region calibration; cone/sector angle from a mask-boundary geometric line fit on the MaskedCone image.

datasetInput.size: 1 DICOM per case; dimensions vary (611-1259 x 484-823 px, see DICOM Rows/Columns)
datasetInput.organization: Files under Benchmarking_Confirmed/<batch>/<CASE_ID>/<CASE_ID>.dcm; each test point in the test_points recordSet carries its exact relative path.
datasetInput.preprocessing: MaskedCone: cropped to the ultrasound sector, scanner UI removed. No intensity normalization applied.

result.outputColumns: case, xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax, confidence
result.outputDescription: Pixel coordinates in the source image's own frame, xmax/ymax exclusive (half-open, so width = xmax - xmin). One row per case; emit no row for a case where the model detects nothing.
